messages:
Anna (People Ops): FYI — Eli Park submitted a resignation yesterday, last day 2026-06-12. Need to line up benefits cutoff, COBRA packet, interview, and access removal timeline. Can people chime in?
Eli Park: Thanks all — happy to help with handoff. Last client demos on 6/10, available for transfer docs 6/11-6/12.
Julia (HR): Noted. We'll trigger COBRA notices. Anna, do we have a benefits termination date preference? Usually benefits run through the last day of the month, but for US-based employees we can offer COBRA starting the day after termination.
Anna (People Ops): Eli is US-based but recently traveled to the EU — still on US benefits. Let's end employer-covered benefits on 2026-06-30 to avoid mid-month gaps and send COBRA enrollment info on 2026-07-01. Is that ok?
Eli Park: That works for me — appreciate the extra month.
Mike (IT): Heads up on access: plan is SSO deprovision on 2026-06-13 (next business day after last day), laptop return by 2026-06-15. Can someone confirm if Eli has any VIP service tokens we need to rotate early?
Sam (Eng): Eli still owns the service account for the staging model-serving cluster (redwood-staging-svc). I can rotate that but need to schedule a 30m window to update the runner tasks. Prefer to rotate on 6/14 AM PST.
Anna (People Ops): @Sam please schedule and ping @Mike when scheduled. Also we'll add a checkbox for KMS key access handoff in the exit checklist.
Mike (IT): Created ticket IT-7248 for device pickup + SSO deprovision. ETA for pickup scheduling email: today. Laptop return address: Office HQ or pre-paid return label if remote. Eli, do you prefer pre-paid label?
Eli Park: Remote — please send pre-paid label. I'll drop off at USPS on 6/13 and confirm with tracking.
Julia (HR): I'll draft the COBRA + benefits termination email. Also schedule exit interview — options: 6/15 10:00am or 6/16 3:00pm PT. Which works?
Eli Park: 6/16 3pm PT works best.
Sam (Eng): For code repos: Eli, can you point where the last PRs and the open TODOs are? I will assign code ownership to @Nora.
Eli Park: PR list: #412, #415 (waiting on review), #421 (blocked by infra). TODOs in repo README and project board; I'll update cards by 6/11 EOD.
Mike (IT): deprovision-bot scheduled a temporary hold: 
"deprovision-bot: hold placed on account eli.park until 2026-06-13 09:00:00 UTC. After that, SSO deprovision will run. If an exception is needed, reply with APPROVE and reason."
Anna (People Ops): Note: final paycheck and unused PTO payout processed on normal payroll cycle. Payroll cutoff for June is 2026-06-20 — we will include final compensation in the 6/30 payroll.
Julia (HR): COBRA packet will be sent via email and US mail (hard copy) on 2026-07-01. Eli, confirm preferred home address for hard copy?
Eli Park: Use my current address on file (confirmed).
Sam (Eng): Confirmed for service token rotation on 6/14 09:00 PT. I'll post post-rotation checklist.
Mike (IT): Ticket IT-7248 updated: pickup label sent (tracking 9400 1111 2222 3333). SSO deprovision scheduled 2026-06-13 09:00 UTC. Please remove any personal MFA devices from the account before then.
Anna (People Ops): Reminder to people-ops: update offboarding tracker row for Eli with: last day 2026-06-12, benefits end 2026-06-30, COBRA 2026-07-01, laptop return tracking, exit interview 2026-06-16 15:00 PT.
Eli Park: Thanks everyone — will complete handoff notes and the access checklist by EOD 6/11. Appreciate the smooth coordination.
deprovision-bot: Note: auto-reminder scheduled 2026-06-12 16:00 UTC to confirm laptop shipped and PRs assigned.
Anna (People Ops): Perfect — I'll close the loop once deprovision completes. :heart:
